flavors.name: Living Code Night
flavors.description: The default. Dark slate ground, teal structure, green strings and gray comments. Amber warnings and copper numbers keep their warm contrast.

flavors.name: Living Code Frost
flavors.description: Night on a lifted, bluer slate with a third less chroma. Calmer for long sessions; the warm/cool split survives at low saturation.

flavors.name: Living Code Paper
flavors.description: Daylight. Same two temperatures on near-white slate, lightness inverted so every syntax color keeps WCAG AA contrast.

flavors.name: Living Code Signal
flavors.description: A minimal variant of Night with a single accent. Teal marks keywords, tags and focus; everything else stays on the slate ramp. No warm literals or multicolor diagnostics.
